0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-6, tenth in the East and third in the Central, 3.5 games back) face the Denver Nuggets (4-3, ninth in the West) in the NBA Mexico City Game, a neutral-site regular season game where Indiana is the designated home team. Indiana has won its last game, is 3-2 on the road but 0-4 at home, and is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain; 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee; 3.0 points per game), and Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost 0-2 to Denver, most recently 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
